name: McMaster University
description: McMaster University is a public research university in Hamilton, Ontario, founded in 1887. It is known for health sciences and its problem-based learning approach in medicine, as well as engineering and business.
whyIncluded: Its Michael G. DeGroote School of Medicine MD is on the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable basic medical qualifications.

livingCosts.notes: McMaster publishes no off-campus budget, so on-campus figures are used. Housing = Residence Fees 2026-27 'Double Room' $9,220 for the 8-month academic year (cheapest standard room; traditional triple/quad rooms are $6,750/$6,550). Food = Trad A residence meal plan $7,280 for the full academic year from Hospitality Services (https://hospitality.mcmaster.ca/meal-plans-and-cards/meal-plans/residence-meal-plans/). Transport 0: HSR bus pass is included in compulsory MSU fees. Personal 0: no university estimate. Residence application fee ($100) and $500 deposit excluded.
